source.primary_metadata_rule: StationXML is authoritative for historical deployment coordinates and instrument response in the EarthScope holding.
source.primary_network_custodian_context: CTBTO primarily maintains H10 hydroacoustic stations.
source.availability_gap_service_state: No programmatic whole-history hydrophone-gap service was available at reply time; MUSTANG does not support hydrophone channels.
source.event_catalog_state: EarthScope does not maintain a hydrophone event catalog.

required_v2_behavior: Always bind waveform epochs to the matching StationXML response epoch before amplitude-sensitive comparison.
Keep raw and response-corrected metrics side by side; response correction may not silently replace raw diagnostics.
Absence of an availability-service result is not evidence of waveform absence.
Do not infer event absence from EarthScope lacking an event catalog.
Treat station maintenance/gap history as an external instrument-awareness layer when the replacement availability service becomes available.
A narrow frequency peak without SNR, sideband and cross-station controls is insufficient.
reuse_policy: HA10 frozen events become calibration/negative-control data for instrument-awareness model development and are not unseen validation for that model.
